ctaHeading: Ready to build in Melbourne? Let's talk.
aboutText: NadiaBuilt is a specialist residential builder based in Melbourne, with over a decade of experience in creating custom homes and renovations. We understand the unique character of Melbourne's suburbs and are dedicated to delivering high-quality craftsmanship tailored to your needs. From initial design to final completion, we handle every aspect of your project with care and precision.
servicesText: NadiaBuilt offers a comprehensive range of residential building services across Melbourne. Whether you're looking to build a new home, renovate an existing property, or add an extension, our team has the expertise to bring your vision to life.

services.title: Custom Home Building
services.desc: We design and construct bespoke homes tailored to your lifestyle and Melbourne's architectural standards.

services.title: Home Renovations
services.desc: Transform your existing home with our expert renovation services, from concept to completion.

services.title: Extensions & Additions
services.desc: Expand your living space with seamless extensions that integrate perfectly with your current home.

services.title: Kitchen & Bathroom Remodeling
services.desc: Update your kitchen or bathroom with modern designs and high-quality finishes.

services.title: Outdoor Living Spaces
services.desc: Create beautiful decks, patios, and outdoor areas to enjoy Melbourne's climate.

services.title: Project Management
services.desc: We oversee every detail of your build, ensuring timelines and budgets are met.
